subject: Signal contract, alert routing & RBAC plan for Integratech
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sahil Patel <sahil.patel@integratech.com>, Integratech - Platform Ops <platform-ops@integratech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Signal contract, alert routing & RBAC plan for Integratech

Hi Sahil / team,

Great kickoff yesterday — thanks again for walking us through your current observability surface. As discussed, the primary goal for the implementation phase is to ensure we ship a clear "signal contract" (what constitutes a high-quality alert), map those signals to Redwood dashboards + tracing hooks, and lock down alert routing and RBAC so your on-call team only receives actionable notifications.

Proposed next steps: 
- Redwood to draft a signal contract and a first-pass alert taxonomy for Integratech by EOD Wednesday (attached).
- Integratech to confirm primary on-call rotations and preferred channels (PagerDuty, Slack, e-mail) by Friday.
- Engineering working session: Thurs 6/24 10:00-11:00 PT — review signal examples, tracing spans to instrument, and RBAC scoping.

I've attached a working draft (signal-contract-v1.md) and a runbook template. Marissa (CS implementation lead) is looped in and will take point on the actual dashboard/tracing configuration. Aditya will oversee timeline and any escalations.

Please reply with any immediate conflicts on the proposed calendar items and who from Integratech should own the final sign-off.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: signal-contract-v1.md (markdown), runbook-template.docx (docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sahil Patel <sahil.patel@integratech.com>, Integratech - Platform Ops <platform-ops@integratech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signal contract, alert routing & RBAC plan for Integratech

Hi all — thanks Kim. Attaching a slightly edited signal contract with a few clarifying examples and a proposed mapping to Redwood alert channels (see attached). Key things I added: 

1) Alert severity buckets and example thresholds (P0/P1/P2).
2) Suggested tracing spans to capture for request-level errors (auth, gateway, model proxy).
3) A proposed alert-to-channel matrix (Slack #ops-alerts for P2, PagerDuty for P0/P1).

I also sketched an RBAC scoping doc — we recommend starting with three roles for the pilot: Viewer, Engineer, Incident Lead. The Engineer role gets dashboard edit and runbook execute permissions; Incident Lead gets escalation permissions to trigger PagerDuty.

Action items for the working session (Thu):
- Walk through two representative incidents (500 spike from model proxy; sustained token-latency increase).
- Confirm which spans are safe to annotate with user identifiers (PII review).
- Agree on channel mappings and escalation window (e.g., P1 -> immediate PD; P2 -> Slack first).

Sahil, can you confirm who will join from Integratech for the PII/Privacy check and final RBAC sign-off?

Best,

Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Attachment: signal-contract-v1.md (updated), runbook-template.docx

From: Sahil Patel <sahil.patel@integratech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Integratech - Platform Ops <platform-ops@integratech.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signal contract, alert routing & RBAC plan for Integratech

Thanks Kim/Marissa — this looks good and close to what we discussed. Quick answers: 
- On-call rotation: Platform Ops owns primary rotation; PagerDuty group is "Integratech-Platform-Primary".
- Preferred flow: P0/P1 -> PagerDuty (immediate), P2 -> Slack #platform-alerts for triage.
- PII review: I'll bring our security engineer, Priya N., to the Thursday session to confirm which spans can carry identifiers. Priya's email: priya.n@integratech.com.

Small ask on the signal contract: can you add one exemplar for a false-positive-prone alert (we regularly surface noisy DB connection pool recoveries that we want to keep out of PagerDuty)? That will help us tune thresholds before the pilot.

I'll confirm internal attendees for Thu by EOD Wednesday.

—Sahil
Sahil Patel
Head of Platform Ops, Integratech

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sahil Patel <sahil.patel@integratech.com>, Integratech - Platform Ops <platform-ops@integratech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 14:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Signal contract, alert routing & RBAC plan for Integratech

Thanks Sahil — noted on the noisy DB case. I've appended an example noisy-signal clause to the signal contract (see updated file) that recommends a 5-minute sustained threshold and a suppression rule for connection-pool-flap events. We'll walk through how that suppression looks in the console on Thursday.

Agenda reminder for Thu 6/24 10:00-11:00 PT:
- 10:00 - 10:15: Introductions and scope review (Kim + Sahil)
- 10:15 - 10:35: Signal examples & taxonomy (Marissa)
- 10:35 - 10:50: Tracing hooks and PII considerations (Priya + Marissa)
- 10:50 - 11:00: RBAC mapping and next steps (Aditya)

Prep items for Integratech:
- Bring one recent alert example JSON export (we'll import into the console).
- Confirm PagerDuty group name and Slack channel webhook.

If that agenda works, we'll lock the calendar and I will start drafting the implementation tickets in our tracker after the session.

Thanks,

Marissa
Implementation Lead, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
Attachment: signal-contract-v1.md (final diff), runbook-template.docx
